componentInstanceProperties.value: When it comes to measuring splines on shafts and gears, investing in the right tool can make all the difference.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue

All manufacturers know that from automotive transmissions to the industrial machinery fields, the precise fit of shaft and gear splines is essential for optimal performance and longevity.
 
However, achieving this precision requires meticulous measurement.

Even minor deviations in spline dimensions can lead to increased friction, premature wear, or even mechanical failures. That's why manufacturers must employ advanced measurement techniques to ensure that every spline meets the required specifications.
 
Among the various measurement technologies available, the VICIVISION Confocal System stands out as a game-changer.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
“Measuring splined shafts has never been so easy”:
NO, that's not just a catchphrase.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue

Measuring a spline shaft is truly easy with the confocal sensor.
Thanks to this combination, the optical measuring machine with confocal can reconstruct the whole profile of the spline and measure it’s features.

What does it mean?
VICIVISION Techno measuring systems with confocal sensor correlate external diameter measured by optics and the internal profile acquired by the confocal sensor.

Some of the key features and benefits of the VICIVISION Confocal System:

  • Non-contact measurement: the measurement is taken without ever touching the part.
  • High-speed image scanning: the part is measured in just a few seconds, enhancing productivity.
  • A truly full inspection of your splines: you will obtain a complete measurement, from basic dimensions to complex geometries insights. 
  • User-friendly interface: discover the intuitive interface of the brand new DREAM software.
